description: This file contains functions and types for managing models and provider configurations in an AI agent framework, including resolving models, handling provider hooks, and error reporting.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeHooks
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate provider runtime hooks based on options.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedTransportApi
methods.description: Normalizes the transport API string to a known set of API identifiers.

methods.name: sanitizeModelHeaders
methods.description: Sanitizes headers object, optionally stripping secret reference markers.

methods.name: applyResolvedTransportFallback
methods.description: Applies fallback transport settings to a model if normalization suggests changes.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedModel
methods.description: Normalizes a model with plugin hooks, fallback, and normalization steps.

methods.name: resolveProviderTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport configuration (api and baseUrl) for a provider.

methods.name: findInlineModelMatch
methods.description: Finds an inline model configuration matching provider and modelId.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration from the overall config.

methods.name: applyConfiguredProviderOverrides
methods.description: Overrides a discovered model with provider-specific configuration.

methods.name: buildInlineProviderModels
methods.description: Builds inline model entries from provider configs.

methods.name: resolveExplicitModelWithRegistry
methods.description: Resolves a model explicitly from registry or inline configs, or returns undefined.

methods.name: resolvePluginDynamicModelWithRegistry
methods.description: Resolves a dynamic model via plugin hooks and normalization.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredFallbackModel
methods.description: Resolves a fallback model based on provider config or defaults.

methods.name: resolveModelWithRegistry
methods.description: Resolves a model from registry, inline configs, or plugin hooks.

methods.name: resolveModel
methods.description: Main function to resolve a model, returning model or error.

methods.name: resolveModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of resolveModel, with retries and dynamic resolution.

methods.name: buildUnknownModelError
methods.description: Constructs a detailed error message for unknown models, including hints.
